# Gelvandale Rugby Academy

> A community-centred rugby development effort in Gelvandale, Gqeberha, Eastern Cape, South Africa. This website is a concept preview; stock media is temporary and current programme/contact details require confirmation from the academy.

## Main pages
- Home: https://rugby-academy.netlify.app/
- About Us: https://rugby-academy.netlify.app/our-story/
- Programs: https://rugby-academy.netlify.app/player-pathway/
- News: https://rugby-academy.netlify.app/news/
- Community impact: https://rugby-academy.netlify.app/impact/
- Media: https://rugby-academy.netlify.app/media/
- Support: https://rugby-academy.netlify.app/support/
- Contact: https://rugby-academy.netlify.app/contact/

## Content notes
- Photographs and videos marked as stock are illustrative placeholders, not academy documentary media.
- Programme availability, eligibility, intake dates, and official contact details should be confirmed directly with the academy.
- Published reporting and quotations are linked to their source pages.

- Sitemap: https://rugby-academy.netlify.app/sitemap.xml
